data.name: Acorn Chipmunk
data.flavor: Buries acorns it will absolutely never find again.

data.name: Alley Cat
data.flavor: Nine lives, and it’s spending every one of them recklessly.

data.name: Ant Scout
data.flavor: First to notice trouble. First to report it, loudly.

data.name: Armored Mastiff
data.flavor: Built like a battering ram with slightly better manners.

data.name: Barrow Leech
data.flavor: Drinks first. Asks questions never.

data.name: Bee Drone
data.flavor: Struck once, and a swarmling boils out immediately to keep the line held.

data.name: Bee Forager
data.flavor: Returns to the hive with more pollen than sense.

data.name: Bee Knight
data.flavor: Small, shiny, and extremely offended by trespassers.

data.name: Bee Sentry
data.flavor: Doesn't sting first. Doesn't have to ask twice, either.

data.name: Beetle Grunt
data.flavor: Polished shell, simple orders, no complaints.

data.name: Black Dragon
data.flavor: Where it nests, even the stone rots.

data.name: Cataphract Destrier
data.flavor: Armored nose to tail in wood-fired steel. The rider is almost beside the point.

data.name: Cave Bat Swarm
data.flavor: One bat is a nuisance. This is never just one bat.

data.name: Cave Flitter
data.flavor: Impossible to hit in a straight line, mostly because it refuses to fly in one.

data.name: Chipmunk Forager
data.flavor: Cheeks full, plans somehow fuller.

data.name: Cobalt Talon Skirmisher
data.flavor: Faster than the wind it rides.

data.name: Colony
data.flavor: Strike it once, and a thousand more answer.

data.name: Cottontail
data.flavor: Fast enough that "catch it" is mostly a suggestion.

data.name: Crimson Wing Duelist Cadet
data.flavor: Practice bouts only. For now.

data.name: Crimson Recruit
data.flavor: Feather-red is earned, not born. This one's still earning it.

data.name: Crossed-Eyes
data.flavor: Looks at two things at once and pecks a third.

data.name: Dominion Nestguard
data.flavor: Sunfeather-born, lodge-sworn to no one.

data.name: Duck Paddler
data.flavor: Calm on the surface. Paddling hard underneath.

data.name: Duckling
data.flavor: Follows whoever moved first. Usually works out.

data.name: Earthworm
data.flavor: Cut it in half and it just keeps working.

data.name: Tomcat
data.flavor: Territorial, uninvited, and somehow already attacking before the round starts.

data.name: Fleetfoot'd
data.flavor: Already halfway down the riverbank before anyone said go.

data.name: Forager Ant
data.flavor: Carries three times its body weight in acorns, and slightly more in grudges.

data.name: Garden Snail
data.flavor: Slow to arrive. Slower to leave.

data.name: Gold-throated Acolyte
data.flavor: Learning the calendar-oaths one verse at a time.

data.name: Green Dragon
data.flavor: The swamp gas you smelled for three days was not the swamp.

data.name: Guppy
data.flavor: Bright, tiny, and absolutely sure it is a shark.

data.name: Harvest Mouse
data.flavor: Lives in the wheat. Knows every stalk by name.

data.name: Honey Bee
data.flavor: One sting, one job, one very short life.

data.name: Meadow Frog
data.flavor: Jumps into every puddle and every fight.

data.name: Meadow Rabbit
data.flavor: Freezes first, runs second, rarely needs a third option.

data.name: Meerkat Wayfarer
data.flavor: Another traveller on the same road. It stands up tall, spots the birds before anyone, and tells everyone else when to swing.

data.name: Mosswing
data.flavor: Builds the nests the war never stops needing.

data.name: Otter Centurion
data.flavor: Slick armor plates lashed from birch bark — first through the gate, first to slide back out.

data.name: Otter Guard
data.flavor: Stands watch at the lodge gate, otter-scout style.

data.name: Otter Paddler
data.flavor: Keeps to the current. The current keeps it moving.

data.name: Otter Riverguard
data.flavor: Holds the ford so the rest of the raft can cross.

data.name: Royal Guard
data.flavor: Sworn to the Rivergate throne. The throne is a log, but the oath is real.

data.name: Otter Shieldback
data.flavor: Carries a driftwood shield strapped to its back. Slides into position, then doesn’t move.

data.name: Owl Nightwatch
data.flavor: Sees in the dark. Flies through the gaps everyone else swears aren't there.

data.name: Pill Bug
data.flavor: Rolls into a ball. Rolls back out. Repeat.

data.name: Pond Duck
data.flavor: Unbothered, unless you're near the nest.

data.name: Pond Trout
data.flavor: Idles in the shallows until the moment it doesn't.

data.name: Quarry Mole
data.flavor: Waits on a resource nobody can spend yet. When Stone finally counts for something, this one will already know how.

data.name: Rabbit Kit
data.flavor: First to the clover. First to the fight.

data.name: Rabid Jackal
data.flavor: Foam at the mouth, fear of the river. Keep it away from both.

data.name: Red Dragon
data.flavor: It doesn't burn the field. It just breathes, and the field forgets it was ever green.

data.name: River Carp
data.flavor: Bigger than it looks from the bank.

data.name: River Warden
data.flavor: Every otter that finishes the run remembers three things: the grip, the current, and who taught them both.

data.name: Riverwing Envoy
data.flavor: An otter with a hummingbird on its shoulder, sent by both courts to keep the peace. Every new friend makes it bolder.

data.name: Sergeant Bramblefox
data.flavor: Barks the orders, then runs in first anyway.

data.name: Shepherd
data.flavor: Puts itself between the flock and the problem, every single time.

data.name: Silver Minnow
data.flavor: Small, quick, and gone before you decide it matters.

data.name: Soldier Ant
data.flavor: Mandibles built for one purpose. It has never once used them for anything else.

data.name: Sparrow Chick
data.flavor: Hungry, loud, and surprisingly brave.

data.name: Stalactite Golem
data.flavor: Falls. Lands. Reconsiders its posture for a round. Falls again.

data.name: Sulfur Cinder Moth
data.flavor: Circles the light until the light stops being safe for anyone.

data.name: Sunspire Choirmother
data.flavor: Every bird that joins the flock joins the song.

data.name: Sunspire Envoy
data.flavor: It didn't win the race. It watched everyone else run it, then it went.

data.name: Sunthroat Courier
data.flavor: Carries messages the Dominion would rather you not read.

data.name: Trash Panda Trickster
data.flavor: Found something shiny in the battlefield rubble. Sold it back to you.

data.name: Tunnel Ant
data.flavor: Knows six ways out of anywhere it's ever been.

data.name: Violet Vane Fletcher
data.flavor: Trims feathers for flight, not for fashion — mostly.

data.name: Voidfeather Scout
data.flavor: Flies the routes with no moon in them.

data.name: Wandering Traveller
data.flavor: No banner, no faction — just a walking stick, a full pack, and a knack for showing up exactly when a new adventure needs a guide.

data.name: White Dragon
data.flavor: The blizzard isn't weather. It's the White Dragon turning over in its sleep.

data.name: Worker Ant
data.flavor: Carries, digs, hauls. Never once complains.
